label: Immune defence
text: BI.O.A3.3 Immune defence. Innate and adaptive recognition, and self versus non-self as a functional distinction with known failures. The antibody as a molecule is CH.O.A3; the system is organismal. Normal immune function is owned here; human immune disorder is MD.O.A1.1.

warrant.standard: Controlled physiology or developmental perturbation; dose–response
